description: Delete DAW sessions in bulk — a SOFT delete (the sessions disappear from the account and every listing; nothing on the user's disk is touched). Select by ids, or by filters (daw_kind, created_before / created_after, name_contains); filters combine with AND. SAFE BY DEFAULT: without confirm:true this is a DRY RUN that deletes nothing and returns {matched, ids}. Always run the dry run first, show the user the count (and names if few), and call again with confirm:true only after they agree. Never delete sessions the user did not ask to remove.

confirm.description: false/omitted = dry run (nothing deleted). true = actually delete — only after the user saw the dry-run count and agreed.

created_after.description: ISO-8601 date/time: only sessions created after this.

created_before.description: ISO-8601 date/time: only sessions created before this.

daw_kind.description: Only sessions bound to this DAW, e.g. "logic", "ableton".

ids.description: Session ids to delete (up to 500), from doseedo_list_sessions.

limit.description: Cap on how many sessions one call may match (default and max 1000).

name_contains.description: Only sessions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

name: doseedo_delete_sessions
